about_short_description.short_description: Streamable is an internet video streaming company that powers innovative video experiences for bloggers and publishers around the world.

product.name: Video Hosting Platform
product.description: A cloud-based service for uploading, storing, streaming, and sharing videos with support for multiple formats and resolutions including 4K UHD.

product.name: Video Editing Tools
product.description: A suite of online tools for basic video editing tasks such as cropping, trimming, merging, rotating, muting, and compressing videos.

product.name: Video Clipping from URL
product.description: A tool to create video clips by importing and trimming videos from external web links without uploading files directly.

product.name: Video Library Management
product.description: A cloud-based system for organizing, tagging, searching, and securely storing large video collections with no upload limits.

product.name: Video Privacy and Security Controls
product.description: Features to control video access including password protection, domain restrictions, and sharing permissions.
